caption: Diagram 1.10 | Alternating tread stair Fixed ladders In dwellings
description:
This diagram, titled Diagram 1.10 Alternating tread stair, depicts an isometric view of a staircase with uniquely shaped steps. The stair consists of a series of treads that have a staggered, cut-away profile to create an alternating pattern. Two long, thin lines represent the 'Handrail (both sides)' positioned on either side of the steps. 

The drawing includes several annotations regarding dimensions and measurements. A vertical double-headed arrow between two treads is labelled 'Maximum rise 220mm'. A horizontal dimension, indicated by a dashed line between the edges of two non-adjacent treads, is labelled 'Minimum going 220mm'. An additional text note explains: 'With this type of stair the going is measured between alternate nosings'. The top left of the diagram contains the instruction 'See paras 1.29 and 1.30'.
